subject: Request: Expanded trial grant for NebulaAI POC — heavy context / high TPM
messages:
From: Jordan Michaels <jm@nebulaai.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nebulaai.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Expanded trial grant for NebulaAI POC — heavy context / high TPM

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. We kicked off internal scoping and want to confirm realistic resource needs for the POC. High level: 6-week POC, multi-turn retrieval-heavy assistant that needs 256k token context windows for embeddings + passage-level KV caching. Expected traffic profile is spiky — steady 200k TPM with bursts to ~1.2M TPM during nightly batch ingestions.

The self-serve trial is great, but with default credits we won't be able to exercise the long-context behavior or peak throughput. Can Redwood increase the initial trial grant to cover heavy-context runs and peak TPM for the POC? Our ask is $25k of trial credit (or equivalent token allowance), 60-day TTL, and the ability to spin up 4 dedicated concurrent model workers for short windows.

I've attached a short POC scope doc. Procurement is cc'd for any contractual language. Happy to hop on a quick call if you want more detail.

Thanks,
Jordan Michaels
Head of Integrations, NebulaAI
[jm@nebulaai.com]

Attachment: nebula_poc_scope.pdf (1 page — architecture & expected TPM)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: Expanded trial grant for NebulaAI POC — heavy context / high TPM

Ben / Laura / Sean — forwarding Nebula's ask. Key points: 6-week POC, 256k context, sustained 200k TPM with 1.2M TPM bursts. They specifically asked for $25k trial credit + 60 days + the ability to spin up a few concurrent workers during peaks.

My recommendation — approve a $20k promo credit with the following guardrails:
- 60-day TTL tied to NebulaAI account only
- Auto-alerting on >60% spend in first 14 days; sales ops to pause further capacity if abuse suspected
- Promo to convert to pay-as-you-go after TTL expires

Risks: 256k context and bursty TPM could consume tokens quickly; ops should monitor throughput and throttles. This is a high-visibility PLG-led account — potential for near-term expansion if POC quality looks good.

If we get Laura + Finance quick ok I can issue the promo code and include onboarding steps + sample batching configs.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
